name: @fahrizkyputra/pi-fast-tools
description: Fewer and faster tool calls for Pi: recursive grep skips node_modules/build output, tests and builds get a timeout, tsc gets a bigger heap, and the model is told to batch calls and use rg/fd. Optional codemode auto-enable.
